source_text: Contra me ipsum locutum me fuisse: qui cum propter meam defensionem dixerim, ab haereticis novis dici nos damnatores esse nuptiarum, operisque divini, postea id abstulerim, dicendo in semis unciis possideri hominem nascentem a Deo et a diabolo, vel potius totum a diabolo possideri, prorsus excluso Deo velut ab universa sua possessione, quod est homo
pass_a_gloss: Against me itself locutum me to-have-been: who when/with because-of my defensionem i-said, from haereticis novis dici we damnatores to-be of-marriages, of-the-work-and divini, afterward it abstulerim, dicendo in half shares to-be-possessed human-being being-born from to-God and from to-the-devil, or rather whole from to-the-devil to-be-possessed, altogether having-been-shut-out to-God as-if from all-things his-own possession, that/which is human-being.

lemmas.lexica: LS nuptiae=nuptials; Blaise Christian marriage good

pass_b_english: [He has] spoken against himself. To defend himself, he said that the new heretics call [him and his party] condemners of marriage and of God’s work. Then he took that back by saying that God and the devil possess a newborn human being in half shares—or rather, that the devil possesses the whole person, with God completely excluded, as it were, from his entire possession, the human being.

choices.why: Julian defends marriage as God's work against the charge that generation transmits sin.
Augustine's quoted claim that the unbaptized remain under the devil; keep the personal devil, not 'evil'.
rejected: under Satan (name not in the Latin here)

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded. Julian is not first-English.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Contra Iulianum / Against Julian), including authorities Julian quoted; Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
